title: SYNTHESIS - Intelligence Engine
summary: A full-stack enterprise platform (React/Spring Boot frontend and backend with a Python AI core) for generating high-fidelity, zero-leakage synthetic tabular data aimed at financial institutions and other data-sensitive industries. Its ai-engine directly imports and runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and CopulaGANSynthesizer, along with SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality, to train, generate, and score synthetic data.
